detail.longDescription: * moved from Redis to Valkey * improved password login workflow * removed cPython code obfuscation flow, because the project is open-source now (CI build time improvement) * deployed live with custom domain (SSL reverse proxy) * Docker Compose workflow for deployment on Linux works * Dagger build workflow (with WSL) works * GitHub Actions image publication works (Dagger) Maybe I will use Daybreak to scan the project for bugs. The password login workflow didn't look well designed from a security perspective. It verbosely stated the PW policy when a login failed. Which is weird. #daybreak #redis #valkey #docker #wsl #compose #dagger
